title: Hanasato Minori — Blessings From My Friends〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, welcome, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Did we catch you guys in the middle of a meeting?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We were talking about doing a show with all of us in it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that would be so spectacular.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. We still haven't actually made a decision yet.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyway, are you girls here to practice as usual?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, and we also have something to report. Minori, if you will.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! We just wanted to say that the Fan Festival is over and tell you all about it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It is?! How'd it go?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I thought I did really well for myself!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I felt really nervous at first and couldn't do what I did during practice, but managed to get back on track after that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was also when I realized just how much Haruka's been a source of support for me and how she's there to help each day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why we need to keep improving as idols...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We need to learn to become independent for everyone else's sake!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can do it, Minori♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll be rooting for you♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, I promise to try my best!!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like you gained some good experience through the Fan Festival.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm glad we gave her the green light to do it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Her circle of friends grew so much too.
It looked like they had quite a bit of fun practicing for it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. They definitely seemed enthusiastic about it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That means we need to use that enthusiasm as fuel for our practices!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So let's get started, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, we'll be waiting stage left.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, I'll see you up there soon!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin, you get that side!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm on it♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here we go! Also, Miku, Rin, Luka, thank you for doing this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's just a formation check for the dance you'll be doing during your stream, yes? Hehe. You can count on us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Minori, is it true that you have your own solo for this dance?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, Airi and the others suggested that I give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This formation ties into that, so they'll be on standby while they wait for their cue.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. I'm looking forward to seeing how this formation turns out♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me three♪

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see. We stand here and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Deep breath... Relax...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not only do you seem much more energetic than usual, Minori, but you also look so fired up now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It's all thanks to the Fan Festival.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It taught me that I'm still not where I need to be yet, but it also made me realize that I don't want to give up and want to keep chasing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You mean after the others?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The others are so great at being idols and I wanted to be just like them...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I knew that it wouldn't be easy either...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it feels like nothing I do is working. It feels like I'm never gonna be able to become a real idol like them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't worry, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You want her to know that she doesn't need to rush, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But she should be just fine. I mean, look.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
See how cute her smile is♪
You can't do that if you feel rushed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just keep making the most of each practice and I'm sure you'll catch up to the others in no time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, I will! I'll try to have more confidence in myself too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great! And we'll be there every step of the way as you move forward.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys, I really appreciate it!
